surah.personality_title: At-Takwir — The Solar Shrouding & The Unveiling of the Cosmic Stage
surah.personality_summary: Apocalyptic, vivid, relentless, illuminating. A continuous cascade of twelve conditional 'when' clauses portraying the cosmic dissolution: sun folded up, stars falling, mountains swept away, pregnant camels neglected, and the buried female infant interrogated for what crime she was slain. Closes affirming the dignity of the angelic and prophetic messengers.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah At-Takwir (The Overthrowing) is the 81th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 29 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ إِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم اذا الشمس كورت
ayahs.translation_saheeh: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When the sun is shrouded in darkness

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when the stars fall, dispersing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the stars are dimmed

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when the mountains are removed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the mountains are set in motion

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when pregnant camels are abandoned

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when the wild beasts are gathered
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when wild beasts are herded together

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when the seas are filled with flame
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the seas boil over

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when the souls are paired
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when souls are sorted into classes

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the baby girl buried alive is asked

ayahs.translation_saheeh: For what sin she was killed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: for what sin she was killed

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when the pages are made public
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the records of deeds are spread open

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when the sky is stripped away
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the sky is stripped away

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when Hell is made to blaze

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when Paradise is brought near
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and Paradise brought near

ayahs.translation_saheeh: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: then every soul will know what it has brought about

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So I swear by the retreating stars
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I swear by the planets

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Those that run [their courses] and disappear
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that recede, move, and hide

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And by the night as it closes in
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the night that descends

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And by the dawn when it breathes
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the dawn that softly breathes

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: this is the speech of a noble messenger

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلۡعَرۡشِ مَكِينࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِنْدَ ذِي الْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ذي قوة عند ذي العرش مكين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who possesses great strength and is held in honour by the Lord of the Throne––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he is obeyed there and worthy of trust

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And your companion is not [at all] mad
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Your companion is not mad

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he did see him on the clear horizon

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He does not withhold what is revealed to him from beyond

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This is not the word of an outcast devil

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So where are you going
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So where are you [people] going

ayahs.translation_saheeh: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This is a message for all people

ayahs.translation_saheeh: For whoever wills among you to take a right course
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: for those who wish to take the straight path

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما تشاءون الا ان يشاء الله رب العالمين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But you will only wish to do so by the will of God, the Lord of all people
